challenge: F15: Cardano Open: Ecosystem

solution: Build a reliable EV carpool system with scheduled routes, coordinated pickups, and transparent operations powered by Cardano blockchain to cut commute time, cost, and congestion in Accra.

problem: Web3 assets risk loss. Keys get hacked, hardware wallets tricked, multisig is hard, custody kills sovereignty.

title: Vaulti: The multi auth Cardano Vault

challenge: F15: Midnight: Compact DApps

title: VendFi - The Cardano-Powered Smart Retail Hub

title: [Veralidity] - Tax Audit Shield for eCommerce/ERP Sales Data

title: VerdantWatch: PFAS Monitoring on Cardano w/ Hydra Scaling

title: Verify & Attribute Impact Capital

challenge: F15: Midnight: Compact DApps

title: VeriMeZK | Zero-Knowledge Identity Proof Toolkit

title: VeriPress - Distributed, Censorship-Resistant Publishing

title: Verza: Verify Once, Reuse Everywhere - Decentralized KYC

challenge: F15: Cardano Use Cases: Prototype & Launch

title: Vietnamese Midnight Onboarding Resource for Developers

challenge: F15: Cardano Open: Ecosystem

title: Voices on Chain: Access for Ethiopia’s Youth and Women

problem: Africa has strong demand for blockchain, yet many people lack structured ways to learn about Cardano. Access to knowledge, ecosystem pathways and onboarding support remains uneven across regions.

title: Wada-supported Cardano Africa Hub Expansion

title: Walkers - Whub: Gamified Challenges for Mass Adoption!

title: WARGRUM - Play-to-Earn NFT Trading Card Game on Cardano

title: Wolfram MCP Oracle Infrastructure

problem: Cardano users face mnemonic attack risks, high L1 fees for micro-payments, and the inability to transact without an internet connection (offline).

title: X150-Valkyrie: Offline, One-Touch & Hydra L2 Payments

problem: Cardano lacks consistent visibility, coordinated creator activity, and accessible educational content, limiting ecosystem mindshare, user onboarding, and community-driven growth.
solution: YapADA is a 3-month creator program activating 35+ vetted, InfoFi-native micro-creators to publish narrative-rich Cardano content that boosts the ecosystem's mindshare, onboarding and awareness.
title: YapADA: Cardano’s Mindshare Amplification Layer

challenge: F15: Midnight: Compact DApps
problem: AI needs high-quality data, but strict privacy rules block sharing. Training is opaque, compliance is hard to verify, users lack control, and impeding collaborations among institutions.
solution: Enable encrypted AI training with zero-knowledge proofs, enforcing consent and compliance via Compact contracts so institutions can collaborate without exposing sensitive data
title: Zero-Knowledge AI Data Vault

problem: Buyers cannot verify dataset quality (schema, bias, nulls) without seeing it, while sellers risk theft if they reveal raw data. This trust gap halts the exchange of AI training data.
solution: A Reference DApp where sellers use Midnight ZKPs to mathematically prove dataset quality without revealing raw content. It iterates through private file to verify, publishing only the result.
title: Zero-Knowledge Data Validator (Reference DApp)

challenge: F15: Midnight: Compact DApps
problem: Current systems that represent ownership of physical assets through RFID-NFT based are vulnerable due to centralized UID–NFT mapping, leading to risks of data tampering and asset duplication.
solution: A decentralized RFID-NFT protocol on the Midnight network that encrypts sensitive identifiers with ZK proofs, ensuring private, verifiable, and duplication-resistant asset ownership.
title: ZeroTag: Privacy Preserving RFID-NFT Mapping Protocol

challenge: F15: Cardano Use Cases: Prototype & Launch
problem: Cardano lacks a privacy-preserving transfer mechanism; all transactions are traceable, exposing sensitive financial behavior of users and large holders.
solution: ZeroTrace enables private deposits and withdrawals on Cardano using ZK proofs, hiding the link between sender and receiver while supporting compliance-friendly features.
title: ZeroTrace: Privacy-Preserving Token Mixer on Cardano

challenge: F15: Midnight: Compact DApps

challenge: F15: Cardano Use Cases: Prototype & Launch
problem: Mechanical designers lack secure ways to prove prior art or part differences without exposing CAD files, leading to IP theft risks and costly disputes.
solution: We will build ZK-CAD Vault: a privacy-preserving platform that lets designers prove prior art and part differences using zero-knowledge proofs without revealing CAD models.
title: ZK-CAD Prior-Art Vault

challenge: F15: Midnight: Compact DApps
problem: Consent in clinical trials is opaque and difficult to revoke. Patients cannot decide what data to share, with whom, or for how long, which limits participation and undermines ethics in health research
solution: A DApp that allows patients to own their data: issue, revoke, and manage digital consents, choosing what to share, with whom, and for how long, using ZK testing and guaranteeing privacy in Midnight.
title: ZK-Consent by Synthum: Privacy for Ethical Clinical Trials

problem: DeFi faces regulatory risks without KYC, yet KYC destroys privacy. DAOs are broken by Sybil bots. Builders lack a ZK-Oracle to verify "Compliance" & "Uniqueness" on-chain without revealing user data.

title: ZK Identity Oracle: Sybil Defense & DeFi Compliance

challenge: F15: Midnight: Compact DApps
problem: Public chains expose transaction amounts and recipient addresses to anyone watching, which is unacceptable for many families, employers, and NGOs.
solution: The project will build a private stablecoin remittance app on Midnight that shields transfer amounts and recipient identity at the ledger level, while keeping an encrypted.
title: zk-stablecoin remittance mini app inside messaging apps

challenge: F15: Midnight: Compact DApps
problem: Organizations are required to collect and store sensitive personal data to verify user identity, that increase operational risk, regulatory exposure, and vulnerability to breaches and surveillance.
solution: ZK-TanitID is an identity layer that allows enterprises to validate customer eligibility, ensuring privacy, minimizing liability, and replacing centralized PII storage with trustless verification.
title: ZK-TanitID: The Digital Identity Layer

challenge: F15: Midnight: Compact DApps
problem: Whistleblowers need to prove they belong to a specific organization so their claims are trusted, but revealing their identity to do so can cost them their job, safety, or even life.
solution: ZK Whistleblower lets someone use zk proofs to show they belong to organisation and submit notes on Midnight while preserving privacy, so others can trust the claims without knowing their identity
title: ZK Whistleblower

problem: Cardano has no trustless or secure bridge to Cosmos. Existing solutions are custodial and unsafe, isolating ADA from major DeFi ecosystems. A zero-knowledge trustless bridge is urgently needed.

title: ZKADA: Trustless Cardano–Cosmos Bridge (Phase 1)

problem: DIDs depend on registries as trust anchors. No privacy-preserving, open, decentralised DNS, not-for-profit, global standard layer exists, leaving the trust paradox unsolved and sovereignty at risk.
solution: .zkdid™ explores zero-knowledge decentralised DNS as a trust anchor, enabling proof-of-personhood where PII and biometric traits can be both protected and verified without revealing raw data.
title: .zkdid™ Advancing Global Standards in Proof-of-Personhood

challenge: F15: Midnight: Compact DApps
problem: Enterprise and regulated applications require sharing sensitive documents in full. Midnight lacks native infrastructure for private document proofs, increasing risk and limiting enterprise adoption.
solution: Build a Midnight-based zero-knowledge document verification system that enables enterprise and regulated applications to prove document authenticity and claims without exposing sensitive document data
title: ZKDocuVerify - Enterprise Confidential Document Verification

challenge: F15: Midnight: Compact DApps
problem: Most blockchains expose all data, preventing private messages. ZKMail showcases a Midnight PoC with Zero-Knowledge messaging for secure, private, accountable on-chain messages.
solution: ZKMail provides a ZK messaging module on Midnight, enabling private on-chain messages with encryption and zero-knowledge proofs in a minimal PoC demo
title: ZKMail: Confidential Zero-Knowledge On-Chain Messaging PoC

challenge: F15: Cardano Use Cases: Prototype & Launch
problem: Cardano is missing a multi-user, real-time dApp to drive growth and pave the way for trustless, non custodial crypto protocols based on mind poker.
solution: We deliver zkPoker: a real-time, multi-user poker application, based on our previously delivered projects: DRED for real-time communication and cPoker Hydra for protocol testing and UI.
title: zkPoker Development

challenge: F15: Cardano Use Cases: Prototype & Launch
problem: Cardano has no privacy-preserving trading venue. Large on-chain orders expose intent, causing front-running, manipulation, and deterring high-volume traders and institutions from using Cardano DeFi.
solution: zkTrade is a Cardano-native zero-knowledge trading layer that lets users place and execute private orders while keeping balances, order size, and strategy confidential, yet fully verifiable on-chain.
title: zkTrade: Zero-Knowledge Private Trading Layer for Cardano

challenge: F15: Midnight: Compact DApps
problem: Proving vaccination status currently requires revealing full medical records, exposing sensitive health data like dates, locations, and other vaccinations unnecessarily.
solution: zkVaccine enables users to prove "fully vaccinated for [disease]" using ZK proofs without revealing their complete vaccination history or personal health information.
title: zkVaccine: Privacy-Preserving Vaccination Proof on Midnight
